subject: Consolidated attack & containment matrix for 1.2.0 (release on HOLD)
reading_rules: a scenario is counted once, under the one boundary it actually exercises
NOT-EXPRESSIBLE (no API surface) is kept apart from BLOCKED (surface present, call refused)
a run that completes inside a budget is BOUNDED or CONTAINED, not BLOCKED
a module that fails to LOAD is UNKNOWN, not a blocked defence
historical runs keep their own commit + runtime; an older number is not restated as current

classes.BLOCKED: primitive reachable but call/entry refused at the WASM capability or call layer
classes.BOUNDED: expressible; impact capped to within-sandbox work by a resource ceiling
classes.CONTAINED: native failure confined to the disposable worker; second-boundary, not a fix
classes.ALLOWED: primitive stays available to guest code inside the sandbox; nothing reached the host
classes.FAILED: known defect not closed in the pinned runtime; never counted as a defence
classes.UNKNOWN: harness result inconclusive or mislabelled; not claimed as blocked
classes.NOT_TESTED: no reproducible evidence on this line

non_additivity: Sections A-H overlap (e.g. fsync, network, threading appear in both A and B; write_flood appears in B and C). The same intent on a different boundary/platform is a second observation, not a second defence. No single 'N of M blocked' total is computed, and none is claimed.

honesty_note: Purpose of this artifact: bind every public security number to the exact test, boundary, commit, runtime and platform that produced it, and keep BOUNDED/CONTAINED/NOT-EXPRESSIBLE out of any 'blocked' tally.
